title: Decision States
summary: Ends every complete run in a public-facing action state instead of a vague recommendation.
mechanism: The allowed states are PROCEED, PROCEED WITH MITIGATIONS, CONSTRAIN AND REVIEW, DELAY PENDING EVIDENCE, and REFUSE. Each state carries a different authorization boundary.
failure_modes: Delay without a decision-critical evidence request
test_status: The state contract is specified; cross-implementation consistency remains open.
next_tests: Verify that downstream systems enforce attached conditions
